note: Tidecaller Drowned Raider (unit identity, Tidecallers): drowned light skirmisher, biped, leaning forward (hunch baked into the bones); a green turtle-shell helmet with a sea-blue rolled edge (the signature), a bloated grey-green body with white eyes, a sea-blue oilskin coat open on a swollen belly, tattered navy trousers, barnacles, a rolled net on the back, kelp streaming from helm, shoulders, forearms, belt and shin, a team neck scarf, hip sash and wrist wraps. The cutlass is in the right hand. No coral. Tier II a bronze sword-shoulder pauldron, bracers and greaves; tier III deep sea-blue plate on both shoulders and shell barnacles on helm and shoulders. No back flag.
